top.title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind five unsolved materials science problems for AI
top.summary: Discovered Materials, a months-old YC startup that uses AI to find chip materials, is offering $200,000 for each solution to five open materials science problems.

topIndia.title: Daksham Capital raises Rs 125 Cr in first close of Rs 300 Cr fund
topIndia.summary: The fund will invest in startups at the pre-Series A and Series A stages, with cheque sizes ranging from Rs 5 crore to Rs 20 crore. It will focus on D2C brands, consumer enablers, B2B2C businesses, supply chains and consumer AI.
